the adoption of games as a learning and teaching strategy can be effective, provided that the game is designed to support learning objectives and is properly used in the learning and teaching process.
the adoption of Serious Gaming is an excellent way to trigger and sustain the motivation and engagement of students in learning and instruction.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of games in the classroom can have a significant positive impact in terms of motivation and engagement, and that it is possible to use them in order to trigger reasoning skills that are transversal to the whole educational process.
games are a very powerful tool for learning and that their use in school should be more and more encouraged.

the adoption of games in the educational process, even in a very simple way, can be an important tool to support the acquisition of reasoning skills and that this kind of approach could be a very effective way to trigger and sustain the interest and engagement of the subjects in the learning process.

the use of Serious Games is not only a promising approach for supporting the learning of reasoning and logic skills, but also an effective and engaging way of doing it.

the use of games for educational purposes should not be limited to the use of computer-based games, but should also include the use of classical board games, which can be played in a very simple and effective way in a classroom.
